checks.finding: design.md ## Architecture (lines 59-106) contains a mermaid flowchart with 4 subgraphs (SA/SB/SC/SD) showing (1) top-level component boundaries -- new unprotected suites (GDF, GNC, WFSCEN) vs. live protected guard binaries (SHGSH/SHGPY/SHGPS/SHGJS) and the protected TESTYML_LIVE file; (2) integration with existing components -- labelled edges show GDF driving SHGSH via a PATH-restricted subshell, GNC driving SHGPY/SHGPS/SHGSH/SHGJS via env-var indirection, WFSCEN's dependency on ADR0010 (Status: Accepted) and LOOPINV vocabulary reuse, and TESTYML_HC -> TESTYML_LIVE human-copy application; (3) technology choices -- the ## Components table (lines 110-121) plus frontend-spec.md's Technology Stack table (the Layer Specifications canonical detail for this layer) name Bash for the suites, GitHub Actions YAML for test.yml, and JSON Schema for the scenario schema. This is a multi-element description of interactions, not a one-sentence component list.

Traced every dependency edge declared in ## Architecture (mermaid, lines 61-106) and ## Components (108-121): GDF -> SHGSH -> {SHGPY, SHGPS}; PWSHSTUB -> SHGSH (command -v only); GDF -> {SHGPY, SHGPS} (decision-parity, read-only); GNC -> {SHGPY, SHGPS, SHGSH, SHGJS}; CWDCORPUS -> GNC; ADR0010 -> WFSCEN; LOOPINV -> WFSCEN; TESTYML_HC -> TESTYML_LIVE; TESTYML_HC -> RC; SELFCHECK -> TESTYML_HC; HUMAN -> TESTYML_LIVE. Every edge points from a new test/staging artifact toward an existing target, or from a precondition (ADR, human) toward a downstream artifact; no target depends back on a new suite. The graph is a DAG -- no cycle found.

This feature has no HTTP/RPC/event-type surface (ux-spec.md and frontend-spec.md both state N/A -- no GUI, no frontend application, consistent with the CI/test-only scope), so design.md's substitution of a full internal-contract inventory for a traditional endpoint list is appropriate and non-empty.
